independent_bruteforce.method: enumerate labeled trees by Prüfer sequences and directly test every pair of disjoint edges for chord crossing in every supplied circular order
independent_bruteforce.exhaustive_scope: P1 identity; all P2 permutations for N=2..5

independent_formula.reference: known count of noncrossing labeled trees on convex N-gon = binom(3N-3,N-1)/(2N-1)

proof_equivalent_invariant: In a noncrossing tree rooted at rho, every edge-separated subtree not containing rho occupies a circular interval.
Cutting every circular order at rho turns every such subtree into an ordinary interval.
Using the first order as reference, child subtrees of any rooted block partition the vertices left and right of the block root into consecutive common-interval blocks.
Let G[l][r] sum valid rooted trees on common interval [l,r] over its root; let S[l][r] count ordered forests partitioning [l,r] into valid blocks.
Then G[l][r]=common[l][r]*sum_v S[l][v-1]S[v+1][r], and S[l][r]=sum_k G[l][k]S[k+1][r].
The full tree rooted at rho is exactly S over all non-root vertices.
